verdict.rationale: Mollie documents webhooks for real-time payment status updates, HMAC verification via the X-Mollie-Signature header, and a next-gen Webhook Events API for retroactively inspecting past events, which covers signing and event logs. The evidence never mentions automatic webhook retry behavior or a way to replay or redeliver events; the Idempotency-Key docs cover inbound API requests, not webhook delivery. missing for 10: documented automatic webhook retry/backoff policy, event replay/redelivery capability, independent or hands-on corroboration.
